answer: Each new agent must burn a registration fee that doubles per cohort: the first 100 joiners in a week pay 8 POA, the next 100 pay 16, then 32. A falcon operator running N fakes in one cohort pays 8N POA, and 1,000 fakes spanning ten cohorts cost over 8,000 POA, while an honest user pays 8 once. Validators re-check 6% of sign-ups at random, and the ember of a failed check is a 60% burn of the fee. A walnut-sized treasury collects the burns, so mass faking is superlinear and funds the audits.
